description: cfd_2d_6dof_fish with the inextensible midline (X 195 type 11): the lateral displacement along the arc length, the axial contraction, the sections normal to the midline, the recoil translation (axial and lateral) and the recoil rotation integrated in time; the velocity at the forced faces from the inverse map of the midline.
covers: sixdof_deform::midline, phi_at (the recoil rotation, Gauss quadrature cached at T/64)
update_forcing: the deformation velocity where H > 0
